      "category": "network_architecture",
      "rationale": "Add a jointly trained residual bottleneck to each GRU output state before the existing aggregation: h' = h + 0.1*W2(GELU(W1(h))). The bottleneck uses one-quarter of the hidden width. Preserve embeddings, aggregation, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class and loads the residual parameters from the category's single checkpoint.",
      "edits": [
        {
          "find": "        self.gru = nn.GRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                          batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)",
          "replace": "        self.gru = nn.GRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                          batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        bottleneck_units = max(1, hidden_units // 4)
        self.state_residual = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_units, bottleneck_units),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(bottleneck_units, hidden_units),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)"
        },
        {
          "find": "    def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = self.aggregate_states(out, seq)",
          "replace": "    def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.1 * self.state_residual(out)
        out = self.aggregate_states(out, seq)"
        },
        {
          "find": "    def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):

        out = self.aggregate_states(out, seq)",
          "replace": "    def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.1 * self.state_residual(out)
        out = self.aggregate_states(out, seq)"
        }
      ]
